page_title: UNI 1-1 BAY | Union Berlin v Bayern Munich 15/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+2' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

90' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) brings down the pass, looks up and shoots from distance, but it's straight at a defender who unwittingly blocks it. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
89' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
87' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a cross into the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off his line to gather the ball.
84' 1 - 1 Goal! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hiroki Ito (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch for Michael Olise.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Andras Schafer cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Here is a change. Woo-Yeong Jeong is going off and Rene Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Tim Skarke (Union Berlin).
81' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
80' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
78' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.
75' 0 - 1 Goal! A great through ball by Josip Stanisic sets up Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
72' Here comes a substitution. Christopher Trimmel is given a rest as he is replaced by Tom Rothe (Union Berlin).
71' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
71' The resulting corner, taken by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.

70' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
66' A decent cross gives Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) a chance to score, but he sends his header inches over the bar from close range.
65' Substitution. Serge Gnabry did his best and is replaced by Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich).
64' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.

63' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
62' Rene Wagner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) replacing Janik Haberer.
62' The substitution has been made. Marin Ljubicic (Union Berlin) has replaced Andrej Ilic.
60' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner which is cleared.

59' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Jonas Urbig pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The linesman makes the right call and Union Berlin will have a corner.
58' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
57' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross from the corner, but Frederik Ronnow reads it well and gathers the ball.
55' Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) commits a rough challenge and Florian Exner blows his whistle for an infringement.
54' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
53' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) was probably a bit loose with his words to Florian Exner, who decides to show him a yellow.

50' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Frederik Ronnow pulls off a great save to deny his attempt towards the bottom left corner.
50' Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
50' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
48' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Florian Exner had a clear view and blows his whistle.
47' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the corner with a short pass.
47' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Florian Exner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
45+2' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
45+2' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
45+1' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Bayern Munich earn a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
41' Good team movement sets up Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, but he slices the ball narrowly wide of the right post.
39' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
39' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
37' The ball possession is 17:83.
37' A lofted cross from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
35' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Union Berlin are taking a throw-in.
33' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

33' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Bayern Munich can continue in their attacking effort.
29' The foul by Josip Stanisic (Bayern Munich) was seen by Florian Exner who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
27' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
26' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.

24' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Bayern Munich.
23' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
15' A bullet header by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post.
12' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
11' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich). The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Frederik Ronnow scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.
8' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
7' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) tackles a bit over-zealously and Florian Exner blows for a foul. Bayern Munich earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
5' Harry Kane receives a sweet cross inside the box from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
4' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
4' The Bayern Munich players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Michael Olise (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
1' The first half has just begun.
Bayern Munich will kick the game off.
Florian Exner got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
